name: ReadFlowVersion

parameters.help_en: The flow code. You can view the flow code on the flow editor (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page
parameters.help_zh: 流程编码。在流程编辑器 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码
parameters.name: flow_code

parameters.help_en: The flow version. You can click a flow name on the flow editor (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page to go to the canvas orchestration page and view the flow version, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2937202.html to retrieve the flow version
parameters.help_zh: 流程版本。在流程编辑器 (https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入画布编排界面查看流程版本或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2937202.html获取流程版本
parameters.name: flow_version

parameters.help_en:
The flow version status. Valid values:
DRAFT: draft.
DELETED: deleted.
ONLINE: online.
OFFLINE: offline
parameters.help_zh:
流程版本状态。取值：
DRAFT：草稿。
DELETED：已删除。
ONLINE：在线。
OFFLINE：下线
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The business tenant code. Default value: ALICOM_OPAAS
parameters.name: biz_code

parameters.help_en: The business extension information. Default value: an empty collection
parameters.help_zh: 业务扩展信息，默认为一个空集合
parameters.name: biz_extend
